purpose: Posthoc feasibility audit of whether co-crystal ligand contact-state diversity, available before prospective screening, distinguishes the observed FA10 two-receptor positive case from the EGFR negative case. It is not a trained selector and does not authorize any new docking, protected-data read, or hardware task.

frozen_diagnostic.positive_case: FA10 fixed-k2 selected pair FA10_2PHB_aligned+FA10_5K0H_aligned, which was selected in every Stage102A outer fold and had positive gain in every fold.
frozen_diagnostic.negative_case: EGFR fixed-k2 outer-fold pairs and gains, including the recurrent EGFR_3W32_aligned+EGFR_3POZ_aligned pair.
frozen_diagnostic.pair_outcome: For each target, all receptor pairs are scored only after descriptors are frozen: mean outer-fold BEDROC20 of the pair minus the Stage102A training-selected singleton baseline in the corresponding fold.
frozen_diagnostic.interpretation: A descriptor can motivate an untouched-target protocol only if it places the FA10 positive pair in a nontrivial, pre-specified contact-diverse region while EGFR does not show comparable positive pair gain. No threshold, coefficient, or selection rule is learned in this stage.
